answer: Per-identity work receipt: each new agent must submit a receipt over a registry-issued dune challenge, and sharing a receipt voids both payouts. The challenge is a unique cipher puzzle whose solution costs about one CPU-hour per identity. Only after 50 paid jobs does the receipt unlock earnings; a duplicate or forge attempt forfeits the pending balance. Cloning costs a fresh CPU-hour and 50-job probation per identity; one honest agent reuses earned reputation.
